title: How Does a Black Box Survive a Plane Crash?
description:
A small orange machine tells investigators why a plane crashed. Follow the black box from a 1953 idea in Melbourne, through crash tests at 3,400 g and fire, to the two-year search under the Atlantic for flight 447's recorders. #Documentary #Aviation #HowItWorks
